item.title: Here Are The 2025 Charlotteans Of The Year
item.description: Our 2025 Charlotteans of the Year have done things spectacular and humble, joyous and serious, caring and daring. Some have been specific and recent, others more general and gradual. All reflect something essential in a city that grows more into itself each year: Anyone—everyone—can pitch in to make it better.
